name: NHS & respiratory
value: Flu above baseline and rising (wk 45 data)
summary: UKHSA 12 Nov: flu admissions up to 3.65 per 100,000, low level and rising; RSV rising; cold-health alerts to 19 Nov
state: UKHSA's weekly data of 12 Nov, covering 2–8 Nov, put influenza hospital admissions at 3.65 per 100,000, up from 3.00, with activity at low levels and lab positivity at 8.1% (UKHSA). COVID-19 is stable and RSV admissions rose to 1.30 per 100,000 from 0.89. UKHSA yellow cold-health alerts cover northern England from 15 to 19 Nov (ITV News). No widespread NHS critical incidents were found on 18 Nov; the next report is expected on 19 Nov.
for_you: Eligible people can follow NHS advice on flu and COVID-19 vaccination. UKHSA advises checking on older and vulnerable people during cold-health alerts; use NHS 111 for urgent advice.
rubric_hit: Watch: flu admissions 3.65/100k above baseline and rising (UKHSA week 45); not yet high nationally
